title: M-PESA Business Safety & Scam Detection
desc: Identify secure practices to protect your business receipts and digital wallet keys.
lessonContent: Protecting your digital assets is crucial. Mobile money providers will never ask for your private PIN over the phone. If you receive a phone call claiming there is a transaction error and requesting your credentials, end the call immediately and report the occurrence through your secure user interface.

quiz.question: If a caller requests your mobile money PIN to reverse an accidental transaction, you should:
options: Hang up and report the suspicious contact
Give them a temporary alternative PIN
quiz.hint: No legitimate provider ever needs your PIN over a phone call — not even to 'fix' something.

title: Building a Simple Professional Resume
desc: Structure your skills to secure technical apprenticeships or vocational jobs.
lessonContent: A professional CV lists contact info, key skills, and previous experience in reverse chronological order. Highlighting practical, volunteer, and community projects (such as peer-circle support) demonstrates your leadership capacity.

quiz.question: Which section is the most critical to place at the top of a modern resume for technical work?
options: Contact details and key technical/practical skills
quiz.hint: An employer needs to know who you are and what you can do before anything else.

title: LinkedIn Connection Message Builder
desc: Pick a scenario, then personalize a ready-made LinkedIn connection message.

scenarios.label: Same school as them
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
We are both students at [College/University] and I would like to connect with you on LinkedIn.

scenarios.label: Mutual connection
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
We both know [Mutual Contact] and I see you're connected on LinkedIn. I would like to join your network.

scenarios.label: Alumnus of your college
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
I see you are an alumnus of [College/University], and I look forward to being one too, as a [Your Major] student. I hope you'll consider connecting.

scenarios.label: Works at a company you want
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
We haven't met, but your profile came up when I was looking at openings at [Company Name]. I'd love to connect.

scenarios.label: Fellow group member
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
I'm a fellow member of the [Group Name] LinkedIn group. I hope you'll consider connecting.

scenarios.label: No prior connection
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
I'm a [Your Major] student graduating from [College/University] this year and would appreciate joining your network.

scenarios.label: Met at a conference
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
It was a pleasure to hear you speak at [Event]. Your talk was genuinely helpful for my job search. I'd like to connect.

scenarios.label: They viewed your profile
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
Thanks for visiting my profile! I'd love to connect and learn more about your work at [Company Name].

scenarios.label: Before applying to their job post
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
I noticed the position you posted and have hands-on experience in [Skill]. I'd appreciate connecting to discuss it.

scenarios.label: After applying to their job post
scenarios.text:
Hi [First Name],
I wanted to let you know I applied for the [Position Title] role. I'd appreciate connecting to discuss how I could add value.

title: Application Quality Checklist
desc: Self-check your resume, cover letter, and LinkedIn profile before you apply.

checklistItems.label: I customized this for the specific job/company
I used keywords from the job description
I checked spelling, grammar, and formatting
I asked someone else to review it
My LinkedIn profile has all core fields completed (headline, summary, photo, banner)
I've added 30+ relevant skills to my LinkedIn profile
I've requested at least one LinkedIn recommendation
